payload.text: The heavy oak door slams shut behind you. Torchlight glares off marble floors and a vaulted ceiling. You stand in a grand hall filled with velvet chairs and silent servants. The air hums with the scent of beeswax and old wood. As you turn, you see the others—Leena in a red dress, Vigil with a sword at his hip, Bob adjusting his apprentice's apron. All four of you pause. No one speaks. The silence feels too thick. You know each other's names before the first word is said.
